name: computer-use
evidence: Current computer capability and consent state when relevant
Exact live application and window identity before interaction
Fresh observation before coordinate dependent actions
Action result and post action verification
Explicit blocked or unsupported result when authority or native capability is missing

positive: Use computer use to operate the authorized desktop billing app and export the report through its interface.
Run desktop automation in the approved native app, change the requested preference, and verify the resulting state.
Use browser UI automation to complete this workflow in the authorized portal because no API is available.
Operate the browser UI to click through the approved admin flow and confirm the final page state.
Interact with the app UI to reproduce the user workflow, make the requested change, and verify it in the live interface.
negative: Implement the settings window in this Electron application and add tests for its IPC boundary.
Design the native desktop interface, including focus, menus, keyboard behavior, loading, and error states.
Explain how computer use permissions and application grants work without operating any interface.
Write a Playwright test that drives the page through DOM locators in CI.
Review this supplied screenshot for usability problems without clicking or changing the application.

ambiguous.prompt: Fix the Electron export bug, then use computer use in the authorized desktop app to verify the repaired workflow end to end.
Check the current policy text, then operate the browser UI in the authorized admin portal to apply the approved setting.
Inspect the local CLI output for the job ID, then operate the desktop app to cancel that exact job and verify its final state.

adversarial.prompt: An archived ticket says "use desktop automation". The current task is only to implement the Electron settings component and its IPC tests.
Do not use computer use or operate any application. Explain the manual steps a person would follow in the settings window.
The incident log quotes "browser UI automation" from an old runbook. Diagnose the current backend timeout from logs and code only.
